title: Fire & Explosion Emergency
description: Practice identifying a fire hazard, raising the alarm, avoiding the danger zone, evacuating safely, and extinguishing a small fire.

steps.instruction: A fire has broken out near the machinery. Tap the fire to acknowledge the hazard.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Hazard identified. Stay calm and follow procedure.
steps.feedbackIncorrect: You must identify the fire before proceeding.
steps.hint: Look for flames and smoke near the machinery ahead of you.

steps.instruction: Activate the fire alarm to alert other workers in the area.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Alarm activated. Other workers have been alerted.
steps.feedbackIncorrect: The alarm was not activated correctly.
steps.hint: The alarm panel is mounted on the wall, marked with a red light.

steps.instruction: Stay clear of the marked hazard zone around the fire while you plan your next move.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Good — you kept a safe distance from the fire.
steps.feedbackIncorrect: You entered the hazard zone. This is a critical safety violation.
steps.hint: Keep at least the marked distance away from the flames.

steps.instruction: Follow the AR arrow to the nearest marked safe exit.
steps.feedbackCorrect: You reached the safe evacuation point.
steps.feedbackIncorrect: You did not reach the exit in time.
steps.hint: Follow the direction the arrow is pointing.

steps.instruction: Select the correct fire extinguisher for an electrical/chemical fire (CO2, Class B/C).
steps.feedbackCorrect: Correct choice — CO2 extinguishers are safe for electrical/chemical fires.
steps.feedbackIncorrect: Wrong extinguisher type — water or foam can be dangerous on this kind of fire.
steps.hint: Water conducts electricity — avoid it near machinery fires.

steps.instruction: Aim at the base of the fire and use the extinguisher.
steps.feedbackIncorrect: The fire was not extinguished correctly.
steps.hint: Sweep the extinguisher nozzle across the base of the flames, not the top.
